messages:
Maya: Async check-in for Q2 milestone checkpoint — routing + runtime status. TL;DR: routing feature flags rolled to canary, runtime quantization tests slipped (infra repro), need two CRs merged (#3812, #3820). Owners please confirm ETAs and blockers.

Liam: Routing FFs are in canary and perf looks good from the dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3812 — needs 1 more review from @Devon. :thumbsup:

Devon: @Liam I'll pick up #3812 today. Note: quantization tests failing on fp16 path. Failing assertion at tests/quant/test_kv_cache.py:47 — likely kernel combo mismatch on A100. Can someone paste the failing log?

Priya: Logs uploaded: https://internal/runs/8972 — summary: kv-cache dim mismatch when running quantized kernel. Eng-infra reproducing on dedicated; investigating whether it's a build flag. Test fix in progress, target EOD Thu.

Zoe: Design handoff done for the rollout UX (banner + opt-out modal). Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/Routing-rollout — top frame has dev notes and copy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2025-06-10T14:20Z completed for routing-canary (srv-r1).

Maya: Blocking dependencies: eng-infra is coordinating a kernel update rollout. @Devon @Liam can we fallback to the dense kernel while infra ships the fix? Also CR ownership: #3812 needs @Devon review, #3820 needs @Maya for release notes / copy.

Liam: I can add a fallback flag to the canary config: `REDWOOD_FORCE_DENSE_KERNEL=1`. Quick patch is ready — will open PR in ~20m.

Devon: Great. If fallback works we can continue rollout. ETA for reviewing both PRs: today by 4:00pm PT.

Priya: QA plan: I have a condensed suite to run on staging once the fallback PR lands. Ping me in-thread when merged and I’ll kick it off.

Maya: Quick snippet for ops (put in canary config if needed):
```
# force dense kernel while quant path is flaky
REDWOOD_FORCE_DENSE_KERNEL=1
CANARY_GROUPS=alpha,beta
```

Maya: Summary / next steps:
- @Liam: open fallback PR (~20m)
- @Devon: review #3812 and #3820 by 4pm PT
- @Priya: run QA on staging after PR merge
- @Zoe: finalize banner copy for release notes
If anyone can't meet ETA call it out here. If all green we plan to push to prod next Tue. Thanks!
